title: calandrinia pumila
intro: Calandrinia pumila, commonly known as dwarf portulaca, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Portulacaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calandrinia pumila include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
